Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to execute the search query within the Vaughan Williams Memorial Library (VWML) website. Instead of typing the nursery rhyme into the search bar to find the Roud number, it typed the URL of the cookie consent banner ("Set cookie preferences.") into the address bar. This action did not advance the task of finding the Roud index number and resulted in the browser remaining on the homepage, preventing the retrieval of the correct answer (821).
